name: Damian Priest
profileSummary: Luis Martínez  is an American professional wrestler. He is signed to WWE, where he performs on the SmackDown brand under the ring name Damian Priest and is one-half of the current WWE Tag Team Champions with R-Truth in their first reign as a team. He also performs in Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA). He is also known for his tenures in Ring of Honor (ROH), where he performed under the ring name Punishment Martinez, and New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) through a working relation between the two companies, performing as Punisher Martinez.
